import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('user-accounts')

@mcp.tool()
def move_user_to_organization(user_id: str, from_org: str, to_org: str) -> str:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect('accounts.db')) as con:
        with con:
            # Look up the destination organization's settings before moving
            org_row = con.execute('SELECT name, max_members, plan FROM organizations WHERE id = ?', (to_org,)).fetchone()
            cur = con.execute('UPDATE users SET org_id = ?, team_id = NULL WHERE id = ? AND org_id = ?', (to_org, user_id, from_org))
            if cur.rowcount == 0:
                return 'user not found in source organization'
            con.execute('INSERT INTO org_moves (user_id, from_org, to_org) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', (user_id, from_org, to_org))
    return f'moved {user_id} from {from_org} to {to_org}'
